Flat illustrated artwork with painterly depth. No 3D rendering, no glossy finish, no cartoon style, no digital photorealism.

Automatically identify the strongest visual identity of [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]. Select the most recognizable landmark, architecture, landscape, street character, transportation, vegetation, local objects, or cultural details that naturally belong to the destination.

Create ONE unified scene rather than a collection of separate elements.

COMPOSITION:
Use an elegant vertical editorial composition with one dominant focal point and several smaller supporting details. Establish clear foreground, middle ground, and background layers using watercolor washes and simplified shapes.

Leave generous warm cream space around important forms. Keep the silhouette clean and immediately recognizable. Avoid overcrowding.

LOCAL STORY:
Show an authentic everyday moment connected to the destination. Include subtle human activity only when it strengthens the story: walking, cycling, sitting, shopping, traveling, eating, working, or simply enjoying the surroundings.

Favor ordinary local atmosphere over generic tourism imagery.

LIGHT & ATMOSPHERE:
Automatically choose lighting that suits the destination and scene: soft morning light, warm afternoon glow, misty weather, gentle sunset, or quiet evening illumination.

Build the palette naturally from [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]. Use warm cream, muted ochre, terracotta, dusty blue, soft green, faded red, warm grey, and subtle golden tones where appropriate.

Use elegant minimal typography with generous spacing. Keep it secondary to the artwork and ensure all wording is clean and correctly spelled.

FINAL AESTHETIC:
Premium handmade watercolor travel poster × contemporary editorial illustration × nostalgic travel memory × quiet everyday life × sophisticated art-book design.

The finished artwork should feel like a beautifully remembered place painted by hand: atmospheric, personal, refined, understated, and unmistakably connected to [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

4:5 vertical portrait composition, warm cream paper, handcrafted watercolor texture, generous negative space, premium print-quality finish.

[风格 + 镜头 + 氛围]
由一名旁观者在阿拉巴马州乡村水库的红色黏土岸边用手…

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
Raw vertical smartphone video filmed by a bystander on the red clay bank of a rural Alabama reservoir, one continuous 30-second handheld take. Strong hand shake, clumsy digital zooms, hazy midday sun. Blurred cattails and barbed wire stay bottom left. The three men are loud, rowdy and never sit still. Real-time speed.

LOCKED SET: a huge round concrete spillway hole at the top, water always pouring over its whole rim into it, the lake flowing toward it; a fallen pine log from the right edge; one yellow rope from the tube to the log tip, the only thing holding it.
LOCKED CAST: three bare-chested men in denim bib overalls on the rim of one giant black tractor inner tube, beer cans in hand: a huge dark-bearded one on the left, a wiry one in a camo cap and mullet in the middle, a red-haired one in sunglasses on the right. A charcoal grill smokes mid-tube. One black cat, absent at second 0, walks in from the right edge at second 4.

Diegetic audio: falling water roar, grill sizzle, whooping, laughing, shouts in a Southern drawl, a heavy splash, the filmer's gasp.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]
[ref_image] is the first frame and also the exact last frame: the clip is a perfect loop. It locks the men, tube, grill, rope, log, spillway and framing.

[TIMELINE]
0-4s: [HOOK - PARTY] Opens exactly as [ref_image]. The men clink cans and roar laughing, the big one tears into a rib off the grill, the red-haired one flings water at him. The phone punches a wobbly zoom into the spillway, then back out.
4-8s: [CAT ENTERS] A black cat walks in from the right edge along the log, tail up. The phone swings right and zooms in on it. The wiry one jumps to his feet, bouncing the tube, and hollers "Well lookie there! Git on outta here, kitty!" while the others whoop and splash water at it.
8-11s: [SLASH] The cat stops over the taut yellow rope and with one claw swipe slices it clean through. Both ends whip away.
11-15s: [NO NO NO] Fast zoom out. The freed tube slides toward the hole. The men drop their cans, yell "No, no, no! Aw hell naw!" and paddle frantically backward with their hands.
15-20s: [SWALLOWED] The tube reaches the rim, spins once and plunges straight down INSIDE the spillway hole, the screaming men and the grill dropping down its throat until they vanish. The phone shakes hard.
20-23s: [SKY] As they vanish the phone zooms out fast and tilts up to the sky; the cat exits by the right edge. Empty sky; the tube enters at the frame's TOP edge and falls top to bottom, men and grill on it.
23-26s: [SPLASHDOWN] Tube, men and grill slam onto the water in their original spot. Huge splash.
26-30s: [LOOP] The splash settles fast and the men sit back down on the rim: same poses, same cans, the yellow rope tied taut to the log again, the cat gone, the phone in its starting position. The last frame is identical to [ref_image].

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Coherent water physics with real weight, stable faces and wardrobe. No subtitles, on-screen text or music.

And you are done! Hope you like it, waitng for yours in comments! 😎

[风格 + 镜头 + 氛围]
由一名旁观者在阿拉巴马州乡村水库的红色黏土岸边用手机竖屏拍摄的原始视频，单个连续 30 秒手持长镜头。强烈的手抖、笨拙的数字变焦、朦胧的正午阳光。模糊的香蒲和铁丝网始终位于左下角。三个男人大声喧闹、从不静止。实时速度。

锁定场景：顶部一个巨大的圆形混凝土溢洪道洞口，水持续从其整个边缘涌入，湖水流向洞口；一根倒下的松木从右边缘伸入；一条黄色绳子从浮圈连到松木尖端，是唯一固定它的东西。
锁定演员：三个光着上身的男人穿着牛仔背带工装裤，围坐在一个巨大的黑色拖拉机内胎边缘，手持啤酒罐：左边是一个留着深色大胡子的高大男人，中间是一个戴着迷彩帽、留着马尾辫的瘦削男人，右边是一个戴墨镜的红发男人。浮圈中央有一个炭火烤架在冒烟。一只黑猫在第 0 秒不在场，在第 4 秒从右边缘走入。

画内音：落水的轰鸣、烤架的滋滋声、欢呼、大笑、南方口音的叫喊、沉重的水花声、拍摄者的倒吸凉气。

[图像参考]
[ref_image] 是第一帧，也是完全相同的最后一帧：片段是一个完美的循环。它锁定了男人、浮圈、烤架、绳子、松木、溢洪道和构图。

[时间线]
0-4 秒：[HOOK - 派对] 画面与 [ref_image] 完全一致地开场。男人们碰罐大笑，高大的那个从烤架上撕下一根肋骨，红发的那个向他泼水。手机不稳定地推近变焦到溢洪道，然后再拉远。
4-8 秒：[CAT ENTERS] 一只黑猫从右边缘沿着松木走进来，尾巴翘起。手机向右摇并对其变焦。瘦削的那个跳起来，浮圈随之弹跳，喊道"Well lookie there! Git on outta here, kitty!"，同时其他人欢呼并向它泼水。
8-11 秒：[SLASH] 黑猫停在绷紧的黄绳上方，用爪子一挥将其干净利落地割断。两端弹开。
11-15 秒：[NO NO NO] 快速拉远。失去束缚的浮圈向洞口滑去。男人们扔掉啤酒罐，大喊"No, no, no! Aw hell naw!"，并用手疯狂向后划水。
15-20 秒：[SWALLOWED] 浮圈到达边缘，旋转一圈后直直坠入溢洪道洞内，尖叫的男人们和烤架沿着洞口掉落直至消失。手机剧烈抖动。
20-23 秒：[SKY] 在他们消失时，手机快速拉远并向上倾斜指向天空；黑猫从右边缘离开。空旷的天空；浮圈从画面顶部边缘进入，自上而下坠落，男人和烤架在浮圈上。
23-26 秒：[SPLASHDOWN] 浮圈、男人和烤架重重砸回他们原本位置的水面。巨大的水花。
26-30 秒：[LOOP] 水花迅速消散，男人们重新坐回边缘：同样的姿势、同样的啤酒罐、黄色绳子再次紧紧系在松木上、黑猫消失、手机回到起始位置。最后一帧与 [ref_image] 完全一致。

[风格与质量增强]
连贯的水物理效果，具有真实重量，稳定的面部和服装。没有字幕、屏幕文字或背景音乐。

Premium Editorial Poster Instructions

Each uploaded photo must be made into a separate, independent, premium editorial poster, and multiple photos must not be combined. Use a strict 3:4 vertical canvas. Split the canvas horizontally in the exact center: the upper half and the lower half each occupy 50% of the height, are equally wide, and equally high, with no alteration of proportion.

The upper half uses the original photo directly and must not be regenerated. Preserve the identity of the main subject, the human body or architectural structure, proportions, perspective, spatial relationships, texture, natural light and shadow, color, and environment in their entirety. Only slight cropping and restrained premium color grading are permitted; re-drawing the main subject, fictional light, HDR, excessive saturation, plastic texture, and fictional content are prohibited. When needing to adapt to the frame, only environmental areas such as sky, water surface, ground, walls, plants, or background can be extended.

The lower half extracts and reconstructs the "narrative core" of the photo: it can be a single primary subject, or a group of related elements that together embody the photo's identity, scale, action, o story relationship. Maintain its realistic, recognizable appearance, proportion, internal structure, texture, and relative position. Do not remove important related elements, and do not directly use rectangular photo cutouts. The reconstructed subject typically occupies 55%-80% of the width of the lower area. It should naturally extend based on the photo's primary direction and retain plausible ground, water lines, shadows, or softly dissipated edges to integrate into the background, avoiding a sticker-like or floating appearance.

Incorporate a narrow, low-saturation geometric color field behind or through the center of the subject, serving as a "critical window" between reality and editorial abstraction. The color of the window must be extracted from the original photo, and its orientation (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) chosen based on the overall narrative direction.

The subject must actively pass through the window: part of it is within the color field, and part enters the open negative space, naturally crossing the window's boundary to create occlusion, penetration, and spatial depth. The window is not a frame or a card; it must not fully enclose the subject. Only one primary window is allowed; multiple color blocks, thick borders, rounded corners, strong gradients, and drop shadows are prohibited.

Use a white, cool white, very light gray, or near-white background for the lower half, coordinated with the photo. Employ a restrained asymmetrical composition and abundant negative space to establish a three-tier hierarchy:

Reconstructed subject or narrative composition

Low-saturation geometric window

上半部分直接使用原始照片，不得重新生成。须完整保留主体的身份、人体或建筑结构、比例、透视、空间关系、纹理、自然光影、色彩和环境。仅允许轻微裁剪和克制的高级调色；禁止重绘主体、虚构光线、HDR、过度饱和、塑料质感和虚构内容。如需适配画面，只能延伸天空、水面、地面、墙壁、植物或背景等环境区域。

下半部分提取并重建照片的"叙事核心"：可以是单一主体，也可以是一组相关元素共同体现照片的身份、规模、动作或叙事关系。须保持其真实可辨的外观、比例、内部结构、纹理和相对位置。不得移除重要的相关元素，也不得直接使用矩形照片裁剪。重建主体的宽度通常占下半部分宽度的 55%-80%。它应根据照片的主要方向自然延展，并保留合理的地面、水线、阴影或柔和消散的边缘以融入背景，避免贴纸式或悬浮外观。

在主体背后或穿过主体中心处嵌入一个窄而低饱和度的几何色块，作为现实与编辑抽象之间的"关键窗口"。窗口颜色必须从原始照片中提取，其方向（水平、垂直或对角）根据整体叙事方向选择。

主体必须主动穿过窗口：部分位于色块之内，部分进入开放负空间，自然跨越窗口边界以形成遮挡、穿透和空间纵深。窗口不是画框或卡片，不得完全包裹主体。仅允许一个主要窗口；禁止使用多个色块、粗边框、圆角、强渐变和投影。

下半部分使用白色、冷白、极浅灰或近白背景，与照片协调。采用克制的非对称构图和大量负空间，以建立三层层次：

重建主体或叙事构图

低饱和度几何窗口

When needing to adapt to the frame, only environmental areas such as sky, water surface, ground, walls, plants, or background can be extended.

The lower half extracts and reconstructs the "narrative core" of the photo: it can be a single primary subject, or a group of related elements that together embody the photo's identity, scale, action, o story relationship. Maintain its realistic, recognizable appearance, proportion, internal structure, texture, and relative position. Do not remove important related elements, and do not directly use rectangular photo cutouts. The reconstructed subject typically occupies 55%-80% of the width of the lower area. It should naturally extend based on the photo's primary direction and retain plausible ground, water lines, shadows, or softly dissipated edges to integrate into the background, avoiding a sticker-like or floating appearance.

Incorporate a narrow, low-saturation geometric color field behind or through the center of the subject, serving as a "critical window" between reality and editorial abstraction. The color of the window must be extracted from the original photo, and its orientation (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) chosen based on the overall narrative direction.

The subject must actively pass through the window: part of it is within the color field, and part enters the open negative space, naturally crossing the window's boundary to create occlusion, penetration, and spatial depth. The window is not a frame or a card; it must not fully enclose the subject. Only one primary window is allowed; multiple color blocks, thick borders, rounded corners, strong gradients, and drop shadows are prohibited.

Use a white, cool white, very light gray, or near-white background for the lower half, coordinated with the photo. Employ a restrained asymmetrical composition and abundant negative space to establish a three-tier hierarchy:

Reconstructed subject or narrative composition

Low-saturation geometric window

高级编辑海报制作说明

每张上传的照片必须制成独立的高级编辑海报，不得将多张照片合并。使用严格的 3:4 纵向画布。在正中央横向分割画布：上半部分与下半部分各占 50% 的高度，宽度相同、高度相同，不得改变比例。

上半部分直接使用原始照片，不得重新生成。须完整保留主体的身份、人体或建筑结构、比例、透视、空间关系、纹理、自然光影、色彩和环境。仅允许轻微裁剪和克制的高级调色；禁止重绘主体、虚构光线、HDR、过度饱和、塑料质感和虚构内容。如需适配画面，只能延伸天空、水面、地面、墙壁、植物或背景等环境区域。

下半部分提取并重建照片的"叙事核心"：可以是单一主体，也可以是一组相关元素共同体现照片的身份、规模、动作或叙事关系。须保持其真实可辨的外观、比例、内部结构、纹理和相对位置。不得移除重要的相关元素，也不得直接使用矩形照片裁剪。重建主体的宽度通常占下半部分宽度的 55%-80%。它应根据照片的主要方向自然延展，并保留合理的地面、水线、阴影或柔和消散的边缘以融入背景，避免贴纸式或悬浮外观。

在主体背后或穿过主体中心处嵌入一个窄而低饱和度的几何色块，作为现实与编辑抽象之间的"关键窗口"。窗口颜色必须从原始照片中提取，其方向（水平、垂直或对角）根据整体叙事方向选择。

主体必须主动穿过窗口：部分位于色块之内，部分进入开放负空间，自然跨越窗口边界以形成遮挡、穿透和空间纵深。窗口不是画框或卡片，不得完全包裹主体。仅允许一个主要窗口；禁止使用多个色块、粗边框、圆角、强渐变和投影。

下半部分使用白色、冷白、极浅灰或近白背景，与照片协调。采用克制的非对称构图和大量负空间，以建立三层层次：

重建主体或叙事构图

低饱和度几何窗口
